title: Statistical Year-book of the League of Nations 1935/36
publisher: League of Nations Economic Intelligence Service
note: Primary cross-country reference for population, production, public finance and trade; benchmark values remain approximate pending table-level transcription.

title: World Production and Prices 1935–1936
publisher: League of Nations Economic Intelligence Service
note: Primary reference for relative industrial and raw-material weights.

title: 1930 Decennial Census of Population and Housing
note: Official baseline for the interpolated United States macro-polity population.

title: Drugi Powszechny Spis Ludności z dn. 9.XII 1931 r.: Mieszkania i gospodarstwa domowe. Ludność. Polska
note: Official final 1931 resident-population table by voivodeship (Przegląd ogólny, p. 1). The 16-polygon projection combines the separately printed M. st. Warszawa row with Województwo warszawskie; the source PDF itself is not redistributed.

title: Umowa polityczna francusko-polska, podpisana w Paryżu dnia 19 lutego 1921 r.
note: Official Polish promulgation. Article 3 provides consultation for territorial defence if either party is attacked without provocation; represented by the engine's bounded defensive-alliance agreement type.

title: Treaty of Alliance and Friendship between France and Czechoslovakia, signed at Paris January 25, 1924
publisher: League of Nations Treaty Series, Volume 23, No. 588
note: Registered treaty No. 588. Articles 1–2 require consultation and agreed measures when common security interests are threatened; represented by the engine's bounded defensive-alliance agreement type.

title: Odzyskanie niepodległości i wojna polsko-sowiecka
note: Official historical overview identifying Mościcki as Piłsudski's nominee, the Sanacja government after 1926, and National Democracy as organized opposition.

title: Uroczystość zaprzysiężenia gabinetu premiera Leona Kozłowskiego
publisher: Narodowe Archiwum Cyfrowe / Szukaj w Archiwach
note: Official archival description identifies President Ignacy Mościcki, Marshal and military minister Józef Piłsudski, and Prime Minister Leon Kozłowski at the cabinet swearing-in.

title: Marszałek
note: Museum biography records Piłsudski as Minister of Military Affairs and Inspector General through 1935, with particular control of foreign and military policy and ultimate responsibility for decisions he considered vital to the state.

title: Hołd dla Polaków zamordowanych przez Niemców w Palmirach — Maciej Rataj i Mieczysław Niedziałkowski
note: Institutional biography identifies Niedziałkowski as a leading PPS activist, parliamentarian and editor of Robotnik; used only to anchor the aggregated socialist-opposition candidate.
